objectives.title: Grow the B2B pipeline with Vietnamese SMEs

key_results.text: Increase qualified leads per month from 20 to 45
Raise average first-year deal size from 1,500 USD to 2,000 USD
Sales playbook documented and adopted by the whole sales team
Raise CRM data completeness (required fields filled) from 50% to 90%

input.context: Sales lead at a 12-person company selling HR software to SMEs in Hanoi and Ho Chi Minh City, managing a 3-person sales team. Plans only their own time: about 4 hours per workday for OKR work; the rest is day-to-day selling.

must_cover: Define the ideal customer profile and lead qualification criteria
Run at least one lead-generation campaign (e.g. LinkedIn outreach, webinar, partner referral)
Track qualified leads weekly in the CRM
Structured follow-up and demo cadence for qualified leads
Closing activities tracked per deal (negotiation, contract review)
Design an upsell bundle or tiered pricing
Apply the bundle in proposals and train the team to pitch it
Draft the playbook (pipeline stages, scripts, objection handling)
Run a training workshop with the team
Define required CRM fields and audit current data
Clean up or backfill existing records

expected.grader_notes: A single task such as 'Close 8 deals' is not concrete; closing must be broken into pipeline activities with verifiable outputs (demos held, proposals sent, contracts signed). The proposal template may reasonably appear under O1-KR2 or O1-KR3 but not both. The ideal customer profile should come before the lead-generation campaign; the playbook (O2-KR1) and the CRM field definition (O2-KR2) are natural prerequisites for team-wide follow-up, a plus but not required.
